services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Experience Chicago's iconic waters your way with unlimited access to a professionally maintained fleet of premium vessels. We take care of the cleaning, maintenance, trailering and winterization, so you can enjoy the best of boating, without the hassles of ownership. Carefree Boat Club Chicago offers three unique ways to experience the city from the water. From 31st Street Harbor near Soldier Field to Belmont Harbor in Lincoln Park, with Burnham Harbor in between, each spot provides unbeatable skyline views, easy lakefront cruising, and front-row access to all the best of Chicago summers. Whether you’re planning watersports, a fun cruise, or a relaxing outing with friends and family,

includes: Access to a fleet of boats
One-on-one on-water training with certified trainers
gap: Minimum and maximum age for boating not explicitly stated
blurb: Carefree Boat Club provides members with access to a variety of boats without the hassles of ownership such as maintenance and insurance. Members receive boating education including NASBLA-certified safety courses and one-on-one on-water training. Rentals are available for single or multi-day use with flexible options and locations.
extraNote: One-time initiation fee and annual membership fee; monthly payment option available · Fuel cost is paid by members when boating · Prices and availability subject to change without notice
